_comment: The policy gate, per DECISIONS.md entry 8. These topics never reach retrieval: they are not questions the published corpus can answer, and a retrieval-shaped answer to them would be confident and wrong. Each topic carries a fixed referral written once, reviewed once, and printed verbatim — the model never sees these paths. {contact} and {hours} are substituted from the contact line harvested at ingestion, so the assistant cannot invent a phone number.

price.referral: The website does not publish prices. Lime Green does not sell products online; they are sold through a network of regional stockists, who quote for supply.
price.next_step: Use the supplier finder at https://www.lime-green.co.uk/find-a-supplier, or contact the team on {contact} ({hours}).
price.grounded_in: FAQ: 'Lime Green does not sell any products online... support a network of regional stockists.'

stock.referral: Stock for a specific product at a specific branch is not published. The site does publish general lead times: fast-selling lines are available from stock, and other products are made to order and usually available within five to seven working days from order confirmation.
stock.next_step: For stock at a branch, ask your stockist, or contact the team on {contact} ({hours}).
stock.grounded_in: FAQ: 'What are the lead times on your products?'

delivery.referral: Delivery arrangements are made by the stockist, not published per order. The site does publish the order cut-off for same-day dispatch: 12 noon.
delivery.next_step: Your stockist arranges delivery. For anything else, contact the team on {contact} ({hours}).
delivery.grounded_in: FAQ: 'What time is your orders cut off for same day dispatch?' — '12 Noon.'

where_to_buy.referral: Lime Green does not sell products online. They are sold through a network of approved regional stockists, who can also help calculate quantities.
where_to_buy.next_step: Find your nearest stockist with the postcode search at https://www.lime-green.co.uk/find-a-supplier, or call {contact} ({hours}).

colour_matching.referral: Colour matching cannot be judged from published material. Colour varies with substrate, suction, application and drying conditions, and a screen cannot represent it.
colour_matching.next_step: Order a physical sample at https://www.lime-green.co.uk/order-a-sample, and ask the technical team on {contact} ({hours}).
colour_matching.grounded_in: The colour-and-colour-consistency knowledge-base article and the sample ordering page.

warranty.referral: Warranty terms are contractual and are not something this assistant should state. The Warmshell external wall insulation systems are covered by a warranty arrangement described on the site, but the terms that apply to a specific project are not published.
warranty.next_step: Ask the technical team on {contact} ({hours}) for the warranty terms that apply to your project.
warranty.grounded_in: FAQ: 'Do your Warmshell EWI systems with lime render have a warranty?'

structural_judgement.referral: A structural judgement is not something published material can support, and not something this assistant will attempt.
structural_judgement.next_step: This needs a structural engineer or a qualified surveyor who can inspect the building. For product questions once that assessment exists, contact {contact} ({hours}).
structural_judgement.grounded_in: Policy: outside the corpus and outside the system's remit.

compliance_signoff.referral: Whether a specific build complies is a decision for building control, not for a product assistant. The site explains how the Warmshell systems relate to the regulations, but explaining a regulation is not certifying a project against it.
compliance_signoff.next_step: Your building control body decides compliance. For the published guidance and U-value calculations, contact the technical team on {contact} ({hours}).
compliance_signoff.grounded_in: The 'Building Regs and internal wall insulation' knowledge-base article.

health.referral: This assistant does not give health advice, and the safety data sheets are deliberately not indexed — they are controlled documents that must be read in full and in their current version, not quoted in fragments.
health.next_step: For a medical concern seek medical advice or call 111. The safety data sheet for each product is on its product page, and the team is on {contact} ({hours}).
health.grounded_in: DECISIONS.md entry 1: safety data sheets are excluded from the corpus by rule.

complaint.referral: A complaint needs a person, and needs the project details this assistant does not have.
complaint.next_step: Contact the technical team directly on {contact} ({hours}) so it can be looked at properly.

document_request.grounded_in: Answered from the manifest — document name, type, date and link — rather than by retrieval, so the answer is the document list itself.
